newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Union bank says mark bond helps position.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Union bank says mark bond helps position.

text.p: The Union Bank of Estonia said on Monday that its successful issue last week of a 13.5 million mark bond would strengthen its position in the small Baltic state's banking market.

"In the past, Estonia's banks drew credit resources from donor organizations such as the IMF, World Bank and European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the bank's vice-president Margus Shultz told a news conference.
"Our bond issue shows that western commercial banks now trust the Estonian economy."

The bond issue, divided into 135 bonds with a nominal value of 100,000 marks each, was subscribed to by Germany's Chase Manhattan Bank AG. The bonds have a two-year maturity and carry a floating interest rate tied to the LIBOR of the mark.
